summary: Volato Group filed an 8-K providing unaudited pro forma financials for its acquisition of M2i Global via a merger. Volato's wholly-owned subsidiary, Merger Sub, will merge into M2i Global, with M2i surviving as a wholly-owned Volato subsidiary. The merger requires Volato shareholder approval; a special meeting is set for May 7, 2026. M2i Global's majority stockholder has already approved via written consent. No per-share price, premium, or consideration type is disclosed. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and regulatory clearance; risk-arb centers on deal completion timing and closing conditions.
